name: TryAMM Self-Funding Creator Plans
principle: Keep entry affordable while metering high-cost AI, media, 3D, holographic, storage and provider usage so direct costs, payment fees, reserves and support overhead are covered before profit is recognized.

plans.name: Free / Discover
plans.purpose: Discovery, learning, shopping and light creation

plans.name: Starter
plans.purpose: Affordable first paid step for students, new creators and microbusinesses

plans.name: Creator Pro
plans.purpose: Serious creators and small production teams

plans.name: Studio
plans.purpose: High-volume creators, shows, games and virtual production

plans.name: Business / Agency
plans.purpose: Agencies, production companies, brands and creator networks

topUps.name: HoloGPT Dub Sack 20
topUps.positioning: Affordable mid-size HoloGPT and creator-tool refill

use: eligible image/audio/video/3D jobs according to per-action credit price
dubSackRules.dynamicCosting: Every action debits credits based on actual provider/infrastructure cost class plus target margin; expensive jobs can require additional credits even when purchased with a Dub Sack pack.
dubSackRules.expiry: Do not expire paid credits unless clearly disclosed and legally reviewed; promotional credits may have separate disclosed terms.

microAccess.goal: Allow nickel-and-dime participation without forcing a subscription.
microAccess.rule: Actual credit cost per action is dynamically set from provider and infrastructure cost plus required margin.

economics.minimumHeavyAiMarkupRule: Price metered heavy-AI work at no less than estimated provider+compute+storage+payment+support+reserve cost divided by (1-target margin). Reprice automatically when upstream costs change.
economics.packSafetyRule: Credit packs are denominations, not promises of fixed compute. Internal credit value and per-action debit tables must be calibrated so expected redemption cost plus payment fees and reserves remain below the configured contribution-margin floor.
economics.paymentFeeRule: Before publishing a pack, subtract expected card/payment fees and fraud/refund reserve from revenue, then verify remaining contribution margin.
